# Baron Boutique

> Baron Boutique is an independent bespoke tailoring house founded in Kathmandu, Nepal in 2000. Baron Boutique has spent over 25 years creating bespoke garments with a focus on artisanal craftsmanship, dramatic design, and collector-quality tailoring. From cinematic-inspired coats and formalwear to handcrafted cashmere products, every garment is made with precision, individuality, and attention to detail.

Tailored products are made to each customer's measurements by human tailors, with a free test garment before the final is cut. There is no off-the-rack inventory. 15,000+ clients served. Worldwide tracked shipping.

Screen-inspired garments are recreations based on screen references, not licensed merchandise. Verify prices and timelines on product pages.

## Collections

- [Handcrafted Cashmere](https://baronboutique.com/handmade-cashmere-collection/): Handwoven cashmere scarves, shawls, and sweaters made by hand in Nepal from fiber sourced on the Tibetan Plateau.
- [Men](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/): Bespoke menswear cut from an individual pattern after each order, covering suits, formalwear, outerwear, shirts, and accessories.
- [Men › Accessories](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-accessories/): Hand-finished silk neckties, pocket squares, aviator scarves, and cashmere scarves, made in the workshop rather than sourced from stock.
- [Men › Coats & Overcoats](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-coats-and-overcoats/): Made-to-order overcoats, topcoats, peacoats, and car coats in wool and cashmere, cut to the wearer's shoulders and chosen length.
- [Men › Dinner Jackets](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/dinner-jackets/): Made-to-order dinner jackets in velvet, silk, and patterned cloth, cut to the wearer's measurements as an alternative to a standard black tuxedo.
- [Men › Frock Coats](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/frock-coats-for-men/): Made-to-order frock coats in wool and velvet with a true waist seam and full skirt, for weddings, stage, historical dress, and collectors.
- [Men › House of Velvet](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/velvet/): Made-to-order velvet jackets and coats in premium velvet on a canvas front, from dinner jackets and smoking jackets to dramatic frock coats.
- [Men › Pants](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-pants/): Made-to-order trousers in wool, flannel, linen, mohair, and silk, cut from the wearer's rise, seat, and leg rather than a waist size.
- [Men › Real Silk Eventwear](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-silk-suits-shirts-ties-scarves/): Made-to-order suits, shirts, and trousers in genuine dupioni, raw, satin, and noil silk, with hand-finished silk ties, pocket squares, and scarves.
- [Men › Shirts](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/shirts/): Made-to-order dress shirts in Egyptian cotton, raw silk, and satin silk, cut to the wearer's neck and body rather than to a collar size.
- [Men › Suits & Blazers](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-suits-blazers/): Made-to-order suits and blazers cut from an individual pattern in wool, silk, mohair, and linen, from two-piece business suits to unstructured blazers.
- [Men › Tuxedos](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/tuxedos/): Made-to-order tuxedos in wool with peak, shawl, or notch lapels, cut to the wearer's measurements and owned rather than rented.
- [Men › Vests](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/vests/): Made-to-order waistcoats in wool, linen, and velvet, cut to the wearer's measurements to complete a three-piece suit or to wear alone.
- [Men › Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/): Made-to-order wedding suits for grooms, cut from an individual pattern, including three-piece, linen, and destination-wedding tailoring.
- [Men › Wedding Suits › Destination Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/destination-wedding-suits/): Made-to-order wedding suits for grooms marrying abroad, cut for heat and travel in fresco wool and linen, including cape suits and statement coats.
- [Men › Wedding Suits › Linen Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/grooms-linen-suits-for-wedding/): Made-to-order linen wedding suits for grooms in 100% linen across 18 colors, as two-piece, three-piece, or frock coat, for beach and summer ceremonies.
- [Screen Inspired](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/): Garments recreated from film and television references and cut to each wearer's measurements. These are independent recreations, not officially licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Cinema Classics](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/cinema-classics/): Golden-age and heist-film tailoring recreated in real cloth, from mid-century grey suits to rusty-tan three-pieces, cut to measurement. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Cyberpunk Trench Coats](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/cyberpunk-trench-coats/): Floor-length structured cotton and leather trench coats recreated from screen references, cut to the wearer's measurements. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Doctor Collection](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/doctor-collection/): Time traveler frock coats, velvet coats, and pinstripe suits recreated from screen references and cut to measurement. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Spy Tailoring](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/spy-tailoring/): Secret-agent tailoring recreated as real clothing: pinstripe three-piece suits, naval peacoats, silk dinner jackets, and suede blousons. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Theatrical Villain](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/theatrical-villain-tailoring/): Villain outerwear and evening tailoring recreated in genuine cloth, from purple double-breasted coats to burgundy three-piece suits. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Victorian Detective](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/victorian-detective/): Nineteenth-century detective outerwear recreated as wearable tailoring: frock coats and Ulster coats with true waist seams and full skirts. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Women](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/): Bespoke womenswear cut from an individual pattern after each order, covering suits, dresses, formalwear, outerwear, and accessories.
- [Women › Accessories](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/womens-accessories/): Handwoven cashmere scarves and shawls and hand-finished silk wraps, made in the workshop with color and dimensions specified per order.
- [Women › Coats & Overcoats](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/coats-and-overcoats-for-women/): Made-to-order coats, topcoats, and frock coats in wool and cashmere, cut to the wearer's measurements for shoulder line and length.
- [Women › Dresses](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/dresses-for-women/): Made-to-order dresses in wool flannel, crepe silk, and other cloths, cut to the wearer's measurements for work, evening, and occasion.
- [Women › Pants](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/pants-for-women/): Made-to-order trousers cut to the wearer's waist and hip together, in seasonless wool, linen, and velvet, without the off-the-rack compromise.
- [Women › Screen Inspired](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/screen-inspired-women/): Garments recreated from film and television references and drafted for a woman's figure. Independent recreations, not licensed merchandise.
- [Women › Shirts & Blouses](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/shirts-for-women/): Made-to-order shirts and blouses in Egyptian cotton, oxford, twill, and crepe silk, cut across the shoulders, bust, and waist.
- [Women › Skirts](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/skirts-for-women/): Made-to-order pencil, pleated, and stripe skirts cut to the wearer's waist, hip, and length for work and occasion wear.
- [Women › Suits & Blazers](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/suits-blazers-for-women/): Made-to-order suits and blazers drafted for a woman's figure, in wool, silk, and linen, from pinstripe pant suits to sculpted single blazers.
- [Women › Sweaters](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/womens-cashmere-sweaters/): Hand-knitted Grade A cashmere sweaters made to order in Nepal, with color and proportions specified per order rather than chosen from stock.
- [Women › Tuxedos](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/tuxedos-for-women/): Made-to-order tuxedos drafted from scratch for a woman's shoulders, bust, and waist rather than resized from a man's pattern.
- [Women › Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/wedding-suits-for-women/): Made-to-order wedding suits and tuxedos drafted for a woman's figure, for brides, guests, and mothers of the bride and groom.

## Services

- [Private Label](https://baronboutique.com/private-label/): Baron Boutique offers expert private label and white label production partnership for brands seeking high-quality custom tailored garments (bespoke, MTM suits, shirts, etc.) and luxurious bespoke…
- [Custom Cashmere Gifts](https://baronboutique.com/custom-cashmere-gifts/): Baron Boutique offers a bespoke cashmere gifting service for life's most meaningful occasions, including weddings, corporate milestones, baby showers, and personal celebrations.
- [Retail Partnerships](https://baronboutique.com/retailers-wholesale-program/): Baron Boutique offers comprehensive wholesale partnership opportunities for boutique retailers seeking premium custom-tailored menswear, womenswear, authentic movie replicas, and luxury cashmere…
- [Designer Program](https://baronboutique.com/designer-program/): Baron Boutique's Designer Program provides emerging and established fashion designers with affordable, flexible production support.
- [Natural Hemp Fabric & Clothing](https://baronboutique.com/100-natural-fiber-himalayan-hemp-fabric/): Baron Boutique offers premium 100% natural hemp fabric and clothing production from high-altitude Nepal (1500m-3000m elevation).
